name: send-claim-onward
description: The withdraw shape (spec FR-027): the root sendShieldeds to a callee which claims that exact coin AND makes its own onward cross-contract call to the Signet singleton, in one transaction
note: The withdraw shape landed: root.pay_and_forward sendShieldeds 100 to Mid's ContractAddress and Mid.take_and_request claims that exact coin AND calls the Signet singleton, all in ONE transaction (tx 0082bd3baf3bccf5f0096a75d7be7d9b6e938613a9979a5df58f6bac7a3c5c614b, 3 contract call(s): pay_and_forward, take_and_request, signBidirectional, status SUCCESS). Mid's public custody cell carries the nonce of result.sent (true) and value 100 (true); mid.requests -> 3; the singleton's notification names Mid (true); the change followed the surviving-coin rule (900 = 1000 - 100: true) and was spent later (0054c1f8d39d9a0ba480e094588bee07a9c6035db90379a1666c616eb8c7ef8858). NEGATIVE, run FIRST with the SAME coin and mt_index so a refusal cannot be a wrong commitment index: the same send driving the non-claiming Mid.request was refused (node-rejected / ledger-218); Mid custody unchanged by it: true. Proving 3698 ms, 21608 bytes proven, 28785 ms end to end.
